title: Define HeaderMapNode type and HeaderValue enum in core
description:
Why: the structured header map needs a canonical Rust type that serializes to the correct DAG-CBOR shape — string for single-occurrence headers, array for multi-occurrence headers. This type lives in usenet-ipfs-core alongside the other IPLD types.

What: in crates/core/src/ipld/, add header_map.rs defining:
  pub enum HeaderValue { Single(String), Multi(Vec<String>) }  with #[serde(untagged)]
  pub type HeaderMapNode = BTreeMap<String, HeaderValue>;
The BTreeMap ensures sorted key order for deterministic DAG-CBOR serialization. The untagged enum serializes as either a plain CBOR text string or a CBOR array of text strings with no wrapper tag.
design: serde(untagged) on HeaderValue is the key mechanism — it tells serde_ipld_dagcbor to serialize Single(s) as just the string value, and Multi(v) as just the array, with no enum tag wrapping. BTreeMap (not HashMap) is mandatory for deterministic serialization.
